verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Terraform's plan/apply/test/state workflow and its MCP server for AI agents, but nothing about built-in scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows (e.g., cron-like triggers, scheduled runs). This is a plausible feature for an infrastructure automation platform (e.g., Terraform Cloud scheduled runs), so the axis applies, but no evidence supports it. Missing for 10: any documentation or probe showing recurring/scheduled execution capability, cron-style triggers, or workflow scheduling features.
